ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between primary low-intensity (black) pigmentation and secondary high-intensity (white) speckled patterns. Visual estimate of 70-80% dark pixels to 20-30% light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of irregular, high-contrast white speckles and small clusters (mottling) across the entire visible ventral surface of both lobes. Larger, more contiguous white regions are clustered near the trailing edges and lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations visible along the continuous boundary of both lobes. The peaks and valleys are most distinct on the outer distal margins of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a moderately convex sweep that tapers into sharply pointed, slightly recurved lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters, approximately 5-15 pixels in diameter, distributed across both lobes, indicative of localized surface scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Discrete vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear marks (rake-like patterns) visible primarily on the left lobe, intersecting the darker pigmentation.
